purpose: Teach: 硫黄/料亭/銅像/寒天/紋章/紫色/食肉/露店

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家族で硫黄温泉行ったろ?
lines.en: Riku, didn't your family go to a sulfur hot spring?
lines.style: Bright, genuinely curious. Leans forward slightly. Teasing undertone but real interest—she actually wants to hear about it. Quick pace, friendly.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お祝いで料亭行ったろ?桜
lines.en: You went to a fancy restaurant for a celebration, right? Sakura.
lines.style: Turning it back on her with a small smile in his voice. Calm, observant—not accusatory, just noticing. Level tone, steady eye contact in the inflection.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、公園の銅像に登るなよ
lines.en: Riku, don't you dare climb that bronze statue in the park.
lines.style: Firm but affectionate warning. Slight laugh threaded underneath—she knows he might actually do it. Sharp attack on the first syllable, then settles into mock-stern instruction.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、夏は寒天ゼリーばっか食ってんな、桜
lines.en: You're eating nothing but agar jelly in summer, aren't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry observation, almost conversational. Slight amusement like he's caught her in something harmless but funny. Measured pace, calm delivery—he's not judging, just noting.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家の紋章、かっこいいな
lines.en: Riku, your family crest actually looks pretty cool.
lines.style: Genuine compliment, a little softer than her usual tone. Brief pause before delivering it—like she's admitting something she wasn't planning to say. Warm underneath the casualness.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、紫色のリュック新しく買ったろ?桜
lines.en: You just bought a new purple backpack, didn't you? Sakura.
lines.style: Noticing without making a big thing of it. Gentle observation, like he filed this detail away without trying to. Quiet voice, almost thoughtful—fond attention.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、食肉減らすのは無理だろ?
lines.en: You can't really cut back on meat, can you, Riku.
lines.style: Teasing statement wrapped in affection. She knows this about him and she's okay with it. Quick, light rhythm—the comfort of knowing someone well enough to tease them.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、夏祭りの露店巡り好きだろ?桜
lines.en: You like wandering through the summer festival stalls, don't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Soft, closer. Like he's sharing something he's noticed about her. Slower than before—more intimate. The question isn't really a question; it's recognition.
